description: Screen small molecules with ADMET-AI: 41 learned ADMET/assay endpoints plus 11 calculated descriptors and alerts. Returns per-molecule scores with endpoint units and species; not a human-safety verdict. Supply exactly one of smiles, molecules, csv or sdf. Batch records retain caller IDs and row errors; up to 1000 molecules per operation. File inputs can use immutable tenant artifact references. No salt stripping or tautomer replacement is added. Unknown endpoint names are errors. Use small-molecule structures, not protein sequences; review applicability and assay definitions.
